engineering_envelopes.crossover: forbidden unless an explicit high-speed or pivot state is declared

limitations: Contact/gauge values are measured bookkeeping from supplied geometry and animation samples.
Engineering envelopes are provisional and are not scientific or physical feasibility claims.
No support polygon, friction, impulse, whole-body solve, curve adjustment, promotion, or runtime mutation is performed.
Ground level and mask membership are explicit input policy; inherited penetration is reported, not corrected.

measured.axis_derivation: measured root ground displacement; static forward labels are not consumed

normalization.height_ratio_definition: all support/track/step widths divided by canonical median H
normalization.width_ratio_definition: optional gauge view divided by canonical median W

step_width_normalized.definition: abs(dot(C_next_contact - C_previous_contralateral_contact, L)) / H; successive contralateral touchdown centroids, with H equal to the analyzed-window median hip height; pair only adjacent chronological events with alternating sides and delta_t > 1e-12 s
